tvShow.name: Evening Drink Style
tvShow.overview: "Evening Drink Style" (Banshaku no Ryugi) is a popular Japanese drama about Miyuki Izawa's ritual of crafting the perfect meal to pair with her end-of-day drink, often beer, emphasizing simple pleasures, moderation, home cooking, and work-life balance, a concept resonating with viewers seeking relaxing, relatable content with culinary inspiration. It's known for its calming vibe, focus on delicious food pairings (like lamb with soy-ginger sauce), and promoting a healthy approach to enjoying alcohol.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: As a new employee seeks guidance, Miyuki shares her philosophy on work-life balance. Meanwhile, her carefully planned evening routine faces unexpected challenges.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Miyuki's quest for the perfect evening drink leads her on an unexpected adventure through the city streets and into a local supermarket, where she faces tough choices and surprising challenges.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Miyuki balances her work at the real estate agency with her dedication to fitness, all in pursuit of the perfect evening drink. Her carefully planned routine faces unexpected challenges.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: When work threatens to derail her evening plans, Miyuki must balance professionalism with her personal rituals. Her journey home becomes an adventure in improvisation and culinary problem-solving.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Miyuki's commitment to understanding her clients' needs takes her on an unexpected journey, blending her professional life with her passion for the perfect evening drink. Her creative thinking leads to discoveries both at work and at home.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Miyuki's meticulous approach to her after-work routine takes an unexpected turn when she invites a colleague to join her. Her culinary skills and drinking philosophy offer a new perspective on work-life balance.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: A work camping trip becomes an opportunity for Miyuki to showcase her skills in pairing food and drink.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: As Miyuki goes above and beyond to meet a client's extensive list of requirements, she reflects on her own journey to create the perfect living space for enjoying evening drinks.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Follow Miyuki, a dedicated real estate agent, as she navigates the challenges of work and life while pursuing her passion for the perfect evening drink. Each episode explores Miyuki's approach to both her career and her after-work rituals, showcasing her creative problem-solving skills and unique perspective on finding joy in the little things.
